name: Daki
source:
A god with enormous power.

Due to his ability to cause great chaos among the world, the other gods fear and revile him, callind him an evil god. He seems to know a little bit about Fuuka's ability to see gods living with her. He seems to want something to do with Fuuka, but due to how incomprehensible his actions are, no one knows exactly WHAT he wants from her...
